recipe.identityOffboardingSummary: Confirm who is leaving, route their mail, and remove their access across Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace in a safe order with one approval. Hand work is tracked on the ticket.
recipe.serviceRecoverySummary: Investigate a stopped Windows service, restart it with approval, and verify that it stays up.

startRecipe.title: Offboard a person

person.label: Person leaving
person.useHint: Use a name or email instead

autoReply.label: Auto-reply message
autoReply.defaultWithInheritor: Thank you for your email. {{person}} is no longer with the company. Please contact {{inheritor}} for help.
autoReply.defaultNoInheritor: Thank you for your email. {{person}} is no longer with the company, and this mailbox is no longer monitored.

cutoff.label: Last day (cutoff)
cutoff.now: Empty means start now: approved steps run as soon as the plan is approved.
cutoff.scheduled: Approved steps wait until this time before they run.

keepMailbox.label: Keep the mailbox
keepMailbox.help: Breeze will leave the Microsoft 365 licence in place and add a manual step to convert the mailbox to shared. Removing the licence first would start the mailbox's 30-day deletion clock.

effects.label: What to do
effects.autoReplyHelp: Answers new mail with the message above.
effects.forwardingHelp: Forwards new mail to the inheritor.
effects.mailDelegateHelp: Lets the inheritor read the whole mailbox. Choose this deliberately.
effects.removeGroupsHelp: Removes the person from groups and distribution lists.
effects.removeLicensesHelp: Frees paid licences once mail is handled.
effects.revokeSessionsHelp: Ends the person's active sign-in sessions.
effects.wipeMobileHelp: Removes the work account from enrolled phones. The device itself is not erased.
effects.disableAccountHelp: Disables the account. This comes last, after mail is routed.

devices.label: Devices to collect or lock
devices.help: Optional. Breeze does not act on devices in this recipe: each device you select becomes a checklist item for a technician.
devices.limit: You can select up to {{max}} devices.
